generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tender will not be Considered

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder

The successful bidder, before commencement of work shall produceEstablishment registration certificate registered under labour department, Government of Karnataka . And shall engage only registered construction workers registered under labour department, Government of Karnataka.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 29.1 of ITT
Sub-Leasing/G.P.A of Work is Prohibited

Contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution
The employer reserved the right to accept or reject any of the tender without assigning any reason
One percent Bill Amount of the Successful Tenderer will be deducted as Labour cess
Contractors who have not completed the works in time in this division will not be entitled to Bid and if participated it will not be considered
Item for which 0.00 rate entered will not be paid for by the employer when executed and shall be deemed covered by the other rates & prices in the bill of quantities
Other details can be seen in the tender documents
Ommission and Typographical errors which are in the opinion of the Executive Engineer will not be a ground for claims of extra payment

The Defect liability period is 1 year. The contractor has the liability of maintaining the work done to a period of 1 Year from the date of completion of the work at his cost. Condition 19 The Tenders are invited as per Standard

Royalty charges will be deducted from contractors running bill as the per prevailing GOat the time of payment. During the execution of works if any minor minerals are required contractors have to abide by the prevailing rules and Acts applicable to Minor Minerals. As per the prevailing rules, for any use of Minor Minerals, the contractor has to submit the Mineral Dispatch Permit MDP obtained from Mines and Geology Department. If Mineral Dispatch permit MDP is not submitted by the contractor along with the bill, the prevailing penalty DMF contribution as per Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules 1994 as amended from time to time will be deducted from the contractors bill

The qualification of tenderer will be considered as per clause No.3. Each tenderer should fulfil the subclauses criteria under clause No.3 as mentioned in the Standard Tender Bid Document KW-2 Booklet
Eligible Class-III and above registered Contractor should have to apply

The agencies participating in the tender shall be registered in the Construction Labour Board as per the G.O.No.LD 300 LET 2006 Dated:18-1-2007 and Addendum No.LD 95 LET 2013 Bengaluru Dt:1-4 2013. Also the contractors entrusted with the work shall employ the labours only who have registered in the Karnataka Building and Construction Workers Welfare Board failing which the contractor shall be liable for any further action as deem fit by the authority/ EPF Registration.

All documents enclosed should be attested by Gazetted officer or Government notary. Original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of the tender process, as and when sought for. work done certificate should have all the details CR no, work order issuing date, work completion date and year as mentioned in bid document.

ROYALTY: Commerce & Industries Secretariat Notification No.CI 81 MMN 2014 18th February 2018 (see-sub-rule i of rule 36) Royalty, and Mines & Geology, rules & regulations amendment Act, para 36 & para 92 of 1994 and as per the Circular issued from Director Mines & Geology Department, Bengaluru letter no: No.Ga.Bhu.E/DCB/2024-25, Dated : 24/01/2025 are to be followed.
The contractor shall quote the rates with out adding GST for either materials or works contract(service)
Restriction of public procurement from bidders of certain countries as in order number:-FD/455/EXP-12/2020/BENGALURU/Dated:01-04-2023
The contractor should own/hire/lease a borewell drilling rig registered with Karnataka Ground water authority, Bangalore and Form-7A issued by the competent authority to be uploaded
The Contractor shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document

itemList.description: Geophysical investigation at site for sinking borewells for Providing drinking water to the habitation either through the Hand Pump MWS or P.W.S.S, by vertical electrical sounding by adopting Venner or Schlumbergers's method, including reconnaissance survey of geological formation. Geophysical investigation of existing ground water in the vicinity, its quality, quantity and acceptability of the users, indicating the location of the site, recommended depth of casing pipe required to seal the top unconsolidated formation including an extra depth of 1.0 metre in consolidated formation for proper seating of casing pipe, depth of drilling required to cover full depth of aquifer proposed to be tapped, probable yield and other information required including transportation of instruments and accessories to work site, engaging technical personal and labour required etc. NOTE: 1) Additional rate on item 1&2 is allowed for drilling in over burden and fixing Casing pipes beyond 20 M (for fixing Casing pipes only) a) Above 20 M and upto 30 M - 15%, b) Above 30 M - 30% measurement of overburden is restricted to the depth of casing pipe fixed excluding initial depth of 20M and projection above ground level). 2) A sum of Rs. 100/- is to be deducted for Dry Borewell towards yield test. etc. complete. complete with all lead and lifts as per detailed specification and direction of engineer in charge

Sinking of Borewell of 165mm dia clear using super fast hydraulic rig of capacity 300 PSIG & above 1100 CMF & above in all strata including over burdern upto 20 m.
